stem: During pharmacist consultation, a patient requested a partial fill of Dexedrine at this pharmacy 12 days after issue and now requests the balance on day 28. What controls?

choices.text: Use the federal 72-hour remainder deadline if its alternate trigger can be documented.
Calculate 30 days from the date of the partial dispensing.
Send the balance to any pharmacy selected by the patient.
The same pharmacy may dispense the documented remainder before the 30-day issue-date deadline.
Record the balance as an authorized refill of the Schedule II prescription.

explanation.core_reasoning: 'The same pharmacy may dispense the documented remainder before the 30-day issue-date deadline.' is the governing result. By contrast, 'Use the federal 72-hour remainder deadline.' would require that the first partial fill resulted from the pharmacy's inability to supply the full quantity. The decisive cue appears in 'During pharmacist consultation, a patient requested a partial fill of Dexedrine at this pharmacy 12 days after issue and now requests the balance on day 28. What controls?'.

choice_analysis.A: 'Use the federal 72-hour remainder deadline.' would apply only if the first partial fill resulted from the pharmacy's inability to supply the full quantity; 'During pharmacist consultation, a patient requested a partial fill of Dexedrine at this pharmacy 12 days after issue and now requests the balance on day 28. What controls?' states otherwise.
choice_analysis.B: 'Calculate 30 days from the date of the partial dispensing.' would apply only if Massachusetts measured this remainder window from the partial-fill date rather than issue date; 'During pharmacist consultation, a patient requested a partial fill of Dexedrine at this pharmacy 12 days after issue and now requests the balance on day 28. What controls?' states otherwise.
choice_analysis.C: 'Send the balance to any pharmacy selected by the patient.' would apply only if the law did not reserve the remainder to the pharmacy that made the initial partial fill; 'During pharmacist consultation, a patient requested a partial fill of Dexedrine at this pharmacy 12 days after issue and now requests the balance on day 28. What controls?' states otherwise.
choice_analysis.D: 'The same pharmacy may dispense the documented remainder before the 30-day issue-date deadline.': supported by remainder deadline.
choice_analysis.E: 'Record the balance as an authorized refill of the Schedule II prescription.' would apply only if Schedule II prescriptions could be refilled instead of completed through a lawful remainder; 'During pharmacist consultation, a patient requested a partial fill of Dexedrine at this pharmacy 12 days after issue and now requests the balance on day 28. What controls?' states otherwise.

related_facts: dextroamphetamine (Dexedrine) is used for attention deficit hyperactivity disorder and narcolepsy; it is federal Schedule II and Massachusetts Schedule II.
Only the pharmacy that made the initial patient-requested Schedule II partial fill may dispense the remainder, and the remainder must be filled no later than 30 days after issue.
